name: Cloud of Needles
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser cloud of needles except it deals 2 piercing damage per round and the damage is considered magic for DR purposes. The damage is also considered silver or cold iron for DR purposes, chosen when the spell is cast.
